newsitem.title: USA: Matritech says gets notice for patents.
newsitem.headline: Matritech says gets notice for patents.

text.p: Matritech Inc said Friday it received notices of allowance from the United States Patent and Trademark Office for two of its patent applications covering nuclear mitotic apparatus protein.
The company said the protein is involved in cell replication, and massive replication of cells is a sign of cancer. A large amount of protein is a sign of cancer.
The company said the allowance gives it exclusive rights to nuclear matrix protein for 17 years from the date of the patent grants at least until the year 2014.

The company said it is using nuclear matrix protein technology discovered at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and exclusively licensed to Matritech to develop tests for bladder cancer and colon cancer.
